definitions.gloss: to hang; to dangle; to suspend oneself
definitions.explanation: To be suspended from something, or to hang oneself from a support.

examples.japanese: {鉄棒|てつぼう}にぶら{下|さ}がる。
examples.english: To hang from a horizontal bar.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{吊|つ}り{革|かわ}にぶら{下|さ}がる。
examples.english: To hang onto the train strap.

examples.japanese: {木|き}の{枝|えだ}から{果物|くだもの}がぶら{下|さ}がっている。
examples.english: Fruit is hanging from the tree branch.

notes:
ぶら{下|さ}がる describes something hanging or dangling from a support point. It can refer to objects suspended from above or people hanging from bars, straps, etc.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: ぶら{下|さ}げる (transitive — to hang something)
- Pattern: Xが[support]にぶら{下|さ}がる

ASPECT (ている):
ぶら{下|さ}がっている describes a continuing state: {果物|くだもの}がぶら{下|さ}がっている (fruit is hanging).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄棒|てつぼう}にぶら{下|さ}がる (to hang from a horizontal bar)
- {吊|つ}り{革|かわ}にぶら{下|さ}がる (to hang onto a train strap)
- {枝|えだ}からぶら{下|さ}がる (to hang from a branch)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {吊|つ}るす: to hang, suspend (transitive, more general)
- {垂|た}れる: to droop, hang down (focus on drooping motion)
